decisions.reason: The modular plant concept has already shown a quantified customer saving of over 600,000 euros a year and fits the firm's modular direction, so keeping the option open remains cheap and worthwhile.
As the multi-model flagship line central to the firm's strategy, it warrants continued commitment while its market value is still resolving in a growing industry.
The trommel screen is a low-cost extension of a core category with no negative evidence, so holding the option costs little.

The new multi-model slow-speed shredder line, apparently succeeding the withdrawn Product B, was launched only recently and has a dedicated page, so its uncertainty is unresolved and it should be kept.
The newly launched spiral shaft screen line extends the firm's screening portfolio, and it is too early for its results to justify abandoning it.
